messages:
Maya Patel: quick idea — add a 'roundtrip' replay step when landing new quant profiles; forward-only checks miss late-token drift.
Samir Gupta: +1. replay same prompt set through quant path, compute token-level signed deltas and drift pct.
Lee Chen: need golden prompt bank per model+task, and per-profile provenance: commit|slice|cal-run.
Maya Patel: provenance format e.g. git:abc123|slice:golden-2026-03|run:20260310-2
Jorge Alvarez: ops: replaying everything is expensive. propose shadow replay sample (0.5-2%) with staged promotion.
Samir Gupta: add 'regen_budget' so router can allow limited regenerations (e.g. 1-3% of requests) to remediate bad tokens during rollout.
Maya Patel: config example: precision_profile.name=roundtrip-v2; replay=true; sample_rate=0.01; regen_budget=0.02; provenance=git:abc123|slice:golden-2026-03|run:20260310-2
Lee Chen: telemetry: store token_signed_delta histogram, fingerprint (sha256 of token ids), and sample of full sequences for quick audits.
Jorge Alvarez: backstop: if drift_pct_tokens > 0.7% for 5m OR mean_abs_delta > 0.065 => auto-fallback to higher precision and page on-call
Samir Gupta: also want a local CLI: `ri quant-calibrate --profile roundtrip-v2 --slice golden-2026-03` -> emits artifact JSON ingested by registry
Maya Patel: artifact fields: provenance, stats, failing_prompts (ids), pass/fail, seed model+quant args. registry will gate rollouts
Lee Chen: next step: small RFC addendum for profile lifecycle + ops runbook. will draft and link tests for unit quant-calibrate
ci-bot: branch feature/quant-replay: CI 60 passed, 2 flaky (quant-calibrate flaky on mac builders)
